orc_request.prompt: One BASIC ORC footsoldier enemy sprite for a medieval fantasy tower-defense game, newly designed from scratch. Native 64 x 64 pixel art, full body visible, facing south-east in an elevated three-quarter top-down orthographic view. A stocky muscular ordinary GREEN ORC with broad bare head, heavy dark brows, flat broad nose, pointed ears, square jaw and two small upward ivory tusks. Recognizable orc face, not a goblin, ogre, human or pig. Chunky arms, short strong legs, slightly hunched shoulders, simple worn dark brown leather vest and belt, dull iron belt buckle, rough muted brown trousers and heavy leather boots. Holds one modest crude iron cleaver lowered in his right hand, free left hand loosely clenched. No helmet, horns, crown, magic, giant armor, shield or oversized weapon. Neutral alert standing pose suitable as a later walking-animation source, legs clearly separated and both feet on the same ground plane. Strong readable silhouette, simple deliberate pixel clusters, dark selective outline, upper-left lighting, restrained 32-color palette with green skin distinct from brown clothes and cool iron. Styled to stand beside substantial pale-stone and dark-oak pixel-art tower buildings, but readable at only 30-45 pixels tall. One centered character with clear margins around ears, weapon and feet. No scene, ground tile, props, text, UI, cast oval shadow, antialiasing or blurry shading.
